card.name: Decimal point in p-values
card.fires_on: The decimal point right after "0" in a reported p-value such as "p = 0.03" or "p=0.11", in trial results. Also the point after "p <" in "p < .0001".

modes.label: Point after 0 in p-value
modes.description: The period following the zero in p = 0.xx inside parentheses after a group comparison.

modes.label: Point after p <
modes.description: The period in a p < .0001 style value with no leading zero.

card.writes: It pushes against the letter p, so the model expects the digits of the p-value rather than another p.
card.plain: It marks the decimal point inside a p-value in study results, just before the digits of the significance level.
